title: Use a table as a list
summary: Lua: Use a table as a list. Read position 1.
introduction: A table can act as an ordered list. The usual first position is 1.
learningObjectives: Use a table as a list with Lua

blocks.text: Install Lua 5.3 or 5.4. Save each example as lesson.lua and run lua lesson.lua.
Use a table as a list

blocks.title: Use a table as a list

blocks.text: The ordinary list starts at position 1, so position 2 is dog.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Index zero is not the first list item in ordinary Lua tables.
